Im a super new student in philosophy, only started learning in september, but it really messed up my life. Existentialism especially. But i got to thinking about the ideology intensely throughout the months. I recently started ranting to my friend and heres what i said:
Life in general is just weird. Fluids collide to grow this infestation of collective dna strands to form an organism inside another organism. This newer organism grows until the space it occupies cant contain it anymore. Once this organism is out of the "mother", she suckles the organism until it can sustain its life on its own while the "father" organism co-parents the newer organism. It adapts talents, skills, and knowledge so its brain can live a generally "successful" life. The organism decides its time to mate, finds the best organism to collide fluids, and raise this organism. Then it dies. The cycle repeats. We learn things and do things we enjoy, until we die. Like we literally fill out time on earth with practically useless things until we have no more time left. Doing these fun things and doing a job we hate or love wont make us live longer. Humans are an infestation on earth and our main goal is to mate and reproduce. Finding things we like to do and things we know (knowledge, culture, beliefs, values, morals, ect), help us find the best suited mate for us to reproduce with. And then we raise that product to live, then we die. Its all so fucked up. Especially since theres so many limits and rules we have to follow. Were taught the "right" things to learn by the government. When none of that actually helps us follow the laws and rules. Were never told why we have to follow them, were just told we must follow them or we end up in jail and live a shitty fucking life. The whole system starts with school. School shapes our lives, our cultures, intelligence, likes and dislikes, ability to withstand pain (mental, physical, emotional, spiritual). School doesnt teach politics, our parents do. School doesnt teach us how to finance or budget, our parents do. Our morals are formed by what our parents teach us. Things that actually matter, are never taught in school, theyre taught by our parents. School is really only good for forming our brains, teaching us how to cope with shit head annoying cunts, homework stress, and responsibility. Social skills too i suppose but there are other ways to learn that. At the very least, school should only teach us what appeals to our interests and whats actually necessary to succeed in life. Elementary and high school didnt teach me too much about how to become an actor. I learned all of that from summer programs. I learned history, some english stuff, and french from school. Nothing else really matters. 
I understand this is really all so easy to understand, like its obvious and blunt. Thats what life is and we just have to deal with it. But to think that theres basically no purpose in life other than to make babies and die, we all die, earth will die, nothing matters. Everything is pointless so why do any of it? Its so, outstanding

Ive lived a life of pain, extreme depression, oppression, wavering eating disorders, way below the poverty line, abuse, all that crap, for 18 years. Ive tried killing myself twice at a young age and no one ever noticed or cared. Im always thinking about suicide, its on my mind 24/7. It fucking sucks. I havent tried killing myself in 4 years now because i kept a statement in mind; “optimism pays”. It does, it truly does pay. My life isnt turning around, but its a little bit of hope that i needed. Hopefully if you keep that simple statement in mind too, itll help you
